nom: numbuzin No.9 NAD+ PDRN Glow Boosting Toner

segments.oily: One reviewer with oily skin reports the toner absorbed well and left pores looking smaller.

concerns.spots: One reviewer reports the toner helps clear her skin, alongside hydration and glow benefits, but no other reviewer confirms this effect on blemishes.

extraits.texte: I love the consistency of the toner. Easy aplied, not too watery. I have oily skin and it absorbed well. My pores seems smaller after putting this on.
